expectations: Static-only recall on SCD2 (plan_history) L4 templates is expected to be near zero: the static rules do not know which column closes a version, so every use of valid_to (the as-of lookup valid_to >= t, tenure features, counts of closed versions) is statically clean. Replay catches them; the combined detector's recall on them is the number that matters.

A cutoff read as MAX(label_ts) over the whole spine, and a label counted final exactly `horizon` old, are leaky under the label audit's strict conventions; the detector treats a dataset-level time split as legitimate. Disagreements on such templates are expected.
